title: Inheritance Tax: preventing unintended deductions for liabilities in trust arrangements
text:
The measure will prevent liabilities arising from avoidance arrangements from reducing Inheritance Tax charges in ways not intended by Parliament.

 It will also introduce rules governing how liabilities properly incurred by trustees are taken into account when valuing settled property for Inheritance Tax purposes, making sure the rules apply consistently and providing greater certainty for taxpayers and HMRC
